name: Penpals
source:
The first visual novel created by NeumanProductions, involves two people who had been penpals for several years. During the summer one of them asks the other permission to stay at their place while looking for a future university to attend. The story takes place during the time they are together.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/penpals.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
本作是NeumanProductions创作的第一部视觉小说，讲述两名保持笔友关系多年的人。某个夏天，其中一人为了寻找未来就读的大学，请求暂住在另一人家中。故事便发生在两人共同生活的这段时间里。

[摘自[url=http://renai.us/game/penpals.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
